title: Online Payments
description: Let clients renew their packages online from the client portal. Connect Stripe or Square, then paste the webhook URL into the provider's dashboard.

enable.label: Enable online payments
enable.hint: When on, clients can pay online to renew a package from the client portal. A new purchase is created automatically when the payment succeeds.

mode.label: Mode
mode.hint: Test mode uses Stripe test keys or the Square sandbox. Switch to Live only with live keys.

square.title: Square settings
square.webhookSignatureKeyPlaceholder: Paste the signature key from your Square webhook subscription

secrets.leaveBlank: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
secrets.writeOnly: Secrets are stored write-only and are never shown again.

webhooks.title: Webhook URLs
webhooks.description: Each provider notifies this app when a payment completes. Copy the URL for your provider into its dashboard.
webhooks.stripeHint: Paste this in your Stripe dashboard under Developers → Webhooks and subscribe to checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, checkout.session.async_payment_failed and checkout.session.expired. Then save the signing secret above.
webhooks.squareHint: Paste this as the Notification URL of a webhook subscription in your Square developer dashboard, subscribe to payment.updated, then save the subscription's signature key above.
webhooks.copiedDescription: Webhook URL copied to the clipboard.
webhooks.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the URL and copy it manually.

toasts.selectProvider: Choose a payment provider before enabling online payments
toasts.stripeSecretRequired: Save a Stripe secret key before enabling online payments
toasts.squareTokenRequired: Save a Square access token before enabling online payments
toasts.squareLocationRequired: Enter your Square location ID before enabling online payments
toasts.savedDescription: Run a connection test to confirm the keys work.

stripe.step1: Open your Stripe account and copy the publishable and secret keys from Developers → API keys.
stripe.step2: Add a webhook endpoint with the Stripe webhook URL above and select the checkout.session events.
stripe.step3: Copy the endpoint's signing secret (whsec_...) into the webhook signing secret field.
stripe.step4: Save, run the connection test, then turn on online payments.

square.step1: In the Square developer dashboard create an application and copy its access token (sandbox or production).
square.step2: Copy the location ID of the location that should receive payments.
square.step3: Add a webhook subscription with the Square webhook URL above, subscribe to payment.updated, and copy its signature key.
square.step4: Save, run the connection test, then turn on online payments.
